scope: Proposition 7.2 (Complete-wall factorization) of the manuscript “Conformal Limits of Critical Square-Lattice Random-Cluster Interfaces” (preprints/Conformal-Limits-of-Critical-Square-Lattice-Random-Cluster-Interfaces-October-5-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 223 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b14b09c2088272ae), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 47. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the complete wall, there are probe- independent complex numbers an(R0, L), bounded above and away from zero in modulus for the fixed large L, such that Hfull(z, u) = an(R0, L)hn(z)Jn(u) + o(1) (7.14) uniformly on interior compact probe sets. The error tends to zero with mesh first and then R0 → ∞. No limit of an is asserted or needed.
